title: Azure Storage SAS token appended to a blob URL
summary: A synthetic Azure blob URL with a SAS token (sv, se, sr, sp and sig parameters) appended after the query delimiter.
rationale: Microsoft defines the SAS token as the query parameters appended to the resource URI and says the "?" delimiter is not part of the token, which gives a documented extent: the query string after "?". The storage account, container and blob name before it are the resource address. The sig parameter alone is not the whole token: the signature is derived from the other parameters.

expectation.rationale: Flag, with the SAS token (the query string after the "?" delimiter) as the secret extent. Microsoft states that a leaked SAS can be used by anyone who obtains it and that the "?" is not part of the token.

sources.supports: If a SAS is leaked, it can be used by anyone who obtains it.
The delimiter character ('?') for the query string is not part of the SAS token.
